amendment_scope: input adapter only; all scientific choices copied byte-for-byte as JSON values from v1

data.patient_unit: existing canonical one-record-per-patient split/cluster assumption; no new split or exclusion

evaluation.bootstrap: 1000 synchronized resamples of canonical patient/record units with replacement, seed 20260921, paired across conditions and model predictions; percentile 95% intervals for metrics, drops, and model drop differences
evaluation.comparison: paired with each of the three existing clean-trained ECGResNet-small seeds on identical sorted held-out record IDs; report per-seed and mean ResNet metrics, and clean-to-reversal drops
evaluation.interpretation: exploratory; not fresh blinded confirmation, architecture or SOTA superiority claim
evaluation.primary: TWA clean minus RA-LL AUPRC within each dataset
evaluation.zero_shot: published 150-class logits for name-matched SB and STach separately; no TWA zero-shot score

freeze_access_status.test_input_audit_scope: paths, headers, raw waveform hashes and missing-value counts only

frozen_head.family: three independent L2-regularized linear logistic heads on the 1024-D frozen features, trained clean only
frozen_head.feature_standardization: per-dimension mean and population std from each dataset's existing training split, floor std at 1e-6
frozen_head.selection: highest clean validation AUPRC for each label; tie selects smaller C
frozen_head.solver: sklearn LogisticRegression liblinear, max_iter=300, tol=1e-4, class_weight=None, random_state=20260920
frozen_head.threshold: 90th percentile of clean validation negative probabilities per label, fixed for both test conditions

input_adapter_v2.chapman_v1_reuse: none; recompute all Chapman features and validation-selected head in v2
input_adapter_v2.ningbo_hash: verify every actual waveform SHA-256 against canonical record and frozen split before full run; check ID/hash binding again during loading
input_adapter_v2.ningbo_path: resolve every ID through canonical header_path and waveform_path; header filename may differ from waveform basename if its 12 signal lines reference the canonical waveform; reject missing files or ID mismatch
input_adapter_v2.physical_nan: replace WFDB NaN physical samples with zero before RA-LL permutation or any filter, as in pinned dataset.py
input_adapter_v2.unexpected: reject infinities, unrecognized dimensions/rate/leads and hash mismatches; exclude no records

label_mapping.SB: official tasks.txt SINUS BRADYCARDIA, index 4 (name-level match)
label_mapping.STach: official tasks.txt SINUS TACHYCARDIA, index 6 (name-level match)
label_mapping.TWA: no exact published output; NONSPECIFIC T WAVE ABNORMALITY is excluded from exact-label and zero-shot comparison
label_mapping.zero_shot_scope: SB and STach only, reported separately with validation-fixed thresholds

preprocessing.input: WFDB physical values in mV, 12 x 5000, 500 Hz, 10 seconds
preprocessing.nonfinite_or_schema_mismatch: WFDB NaN -> 0 before fault/filter; reject infinity and other schema errors
order: replace WFDB NaN physical samples with zero
50 Hz iirnotch Q=30 with filtfilt per lead
4th-order Butterworth 0.67-40 Hz bandpass with filtfilt per lead
global z-score over all 12 x 5000 values using population std and epsilon 1e-8
preprocessing.pre_fault: RA-LL terminal permutation on raw physical I, II, V1..V6; derive 12 displayed leads; chest leads invariant
preprocessing.provenance: official util.py::filter_bandpass and dataset.py::z_score_normalization; 500 Hz data need no resampling

runtime.cache: v2-only resumable feature and logit arrays bound to v2 protocol/checkpoint/ordered IDs; completed hashes required before reuse
runtime.inference: CUDA float16 autocast, frozen eval model

scientific_question: Does exact RA-LL cable reversal lower ECGFounder diagnostic performance on the same Chapman and Ningbo held-out records as the saved ECGResNet-small predictions?
scope: exploratory published-pretrained-model baseline; previously examined held-out sets

source.feature: 1024-dimensional global temporal average before official dense layer
source.model: official Net1D, 12 channels, 150 classes, use_bn=False, use_do=False, return_features=True, strict state-dict load
